```{r}
file_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "/4plot/IRIS_place_time_day_tsne.csv")
df_plot_word <- read.csv(file_path)

# Define your color scale limits
min_lat <- 48.6
max_lat <- 49.0

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(df_plot_word, aes(x = x, y = y, color = center_lat)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    name = "Latitude",
    limits = c(min_lat, max_lat),
    #  low = "#4575b4", high = "#d73027", 
    low = "#263C7B", high = "#E9C62E",  
    oob = scales::squish               # Handle out-of-bound values
  ) +
  labs(title = "t-SNE of Location Embeddings color by lat") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
p
```

# All
```{r}
# Define color scale limits
min_lat <- 48.6
max_lat <- 49.0
min_lon <- 2.0
max_lon <- 2.7

# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = file.path(DATA_DIR, "4plot"), pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
# csv_files

# Define a function to create and save plots
plot_lat_lon <- function(df, base_name, method, variable, var_name, limits, suffix) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = !!sym(variable))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colors = c('#798234FF', '#A3AD62FF', '#D0D3A2FF', '#FDFBE4FF', '#F0C6C3FF', '#DF91A3FF', '#D46780FF'),
      name = var_name,
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    labs(title = paste(method, "colored by", var_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  # Save the plot
  Fig_path <- file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig/word_by_latlon/")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(Fig_path, paste0(base_name, "_", suffix, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )
}

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in csv_files) {
  base_name <- str_remove(basename(file_path), "\\.csv")
  print(base_name)

  method <- str_extract(base_name, "[^_]+$") |> toupper()
  df <- read.csv(file_path)

  # Plot and save latitude
  plot_lat_lon(df, base_name, method, "center_lat", "Latitude", c(min_lat, max_lat), "lat")

  # Plot and save longitude
  plot_lat_lon(df, base_name, method, "center_lon", "Longitude", c(min_lon, max_lon), "lon")
}
```

```{r}
# Define color scale limits
min_lat <- 48.6
max_lat <- 49.0
min_lon <- 2.0
max_lon <- 2.7

# Custom color mappings
time_colors <- c(
  "night" = "#798234",   # olive green
  "daytime" = "#D46780", # rose pink
  "evening" = "#F0C6C3FF"    # soft lime
)

day_type_colors <- c(
  "weekday" = "#DF91A3",   # muted pink
  "weekend" = "#798234"    # olive green
)

# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = file.path(DATA_DIR, "4plot"), pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Create output directories if they don't exist
dir.create(file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig/word_by_latlon"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig/word_by_time"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig/word_by_day"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Function to plot latitude and longitude
plot_lat_lon <- function(df, base_name, method, variable, var_name, limits, suffix) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = !!sym(variable))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colors = c('#798234FF', '#A3AD62FF', '#D0D3A2FF', '#FDFBE4FF', '#F0C6C3FF', '#DF91A3FF', '#D46780FF'),
      name = var_name,
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    labs(title = paste(method, "colored by", var_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  Fig_path <- file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig/word_by_latlon/")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(Fig_path, paste0(base_name, "_", suffix, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )
}

# Function to plot categorical variables with custom colors
plot_extra_var <- function(df, base_name, method, variable, var_name, folder_name) {
  # Select appropriate color mapping
  if (variable == "time") {
    custom_colors <- time_colors
  } else if (variable == "day_type") {
    custom_colors <- day_type_colors
  } else {
    stop("Unknown variable for custom color mapping.")
  }

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = !!sym(variable))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, name = var_name) +
    labs(title = paste(method, "colored by", var_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  Fig_path <- file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig", folder_name)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(Fig_path, paste0(base_name, "_", variable, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )
}

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in csv_files) {
  base_name <- str_remove(basename(file_path), "\\.csv")
  print(base_name)

  method <- str_extract(base_name, "[^_]+$") |> toupper()
  df <- read.csv(file_path)

  # Plot and save latitude
  plot_lat_lon(df, base_name, method, "center_lat", "Latitude", c(min_lat, max_lat), "lat")

  # Plot and save longitude
  plot_lat_lon(df, base_name, method, "center_lon", "Longitude", c(min_lon, max_lon), "lon")

  # Plot and save time if available
  if ("time" %in% names(df)) {
    plot_extra_var(df, base_name, method, "time", "Time", "word_by_time")
  }

  # Plot and save day_type if available
  if ("day_type" %in% names(df)) {
    plot_extra_var(df, base_name, method, "day_type", "Day Type", "word_by_day")
  }
}
```
